description: Reporting hierarchy, configured and actual models, token usage and API-equivalent cost per agent and per subtree. Prices refresh daily from public price lists; no agent is involved.
author: mzaferyahsi

jobs.description: Daily HTTPS GET of public price lists (raw.githubusercontent.com, models.dev, platform.claude.com, developers.openai.com). Sends no installation or usage data.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used for day boundaries (whole-hour offsets).

inclusiveInputProviders.description: Providers whose input_tokens already include cached tokens.

heavyShareThreshold.description: An agent using more than this percent of all tokens is flagged as a heavy spender.

lowDataRunThreshold.description: Agents with fewer runs than this in the range are flagged as low data.

priceChangeHoldPercent.description: A fetched price change above this percentage is held until a board member accepts it.

priceStaleAfterDays.description: Prices are shown as stale when the last successful refresh is older than this.

priceSources.description: Enabled price sources in precedence order. Empty means bundled snapshot and overrides only, with no outbound requests.
